name: Ireland
snapshot: A rich, fast-growing country dependent on US tech and pharma giants, where a housing crisis dominates politics and a left-wing independent won the presidency in 2025.
culture: Ireland's literary tradition, from Joyce and Yeats to Sally Rooney, and its music, from trad sessions to U2, punch far above its size. Gaelic games, hurling and Gaelic football, draw huge crowds. Irish is the first official language, and Gaeltacht areas keep it alive. St Patrick's Day is celebrated worldwide by a vast diaspora.
society: Ireland went from one of Western Europe's poorest countries to one of its richest, thanks largely to US multinationals drawn by low corporate tax; Apple, Google and Pfizer have European hubs there. Housing shortages and homelessness are acute. Voters legalised same-sex marriage and abortion in landmark referendums in 2015 and 2018.
baseline: Micheál Martin of Fianna Fáil became Taoiseach again in January 2025 in a coalition with Fine Gael and independents. Catherine Connolly, a left-wing independent, won the presidential election in October 2025 by a landslide.
